source_refs.note: Book p. 103: heading 3.7 Application of Definite Integrals (followed directly by 3.7.1); overview of the section is ours

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab mein heading 3.7 ke foran baad 3.7.1 shuru ho jata hai, is liye is page par sirf is section ka naqsha (plan) hai; yeh hamari taraf se overview hai.
Ab tak hum ne seekha ke definite integral \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\) ki value kaise nikalte hain. Ab sawal yeh hai: is value ka faida kya hai? Is section mein hum isi integral se asal cheezein naapenge (measure karenge):
1. 3.7.1 Curve ke neeche ka area, aur do curves ke darmiyan ka area.
2. 3.7.2 Economics mein consumer surplus aur producer surplus (yani demand ya supply curve aur ek price line ke darmiyan ka area).
3. 3.7.3 Solid ka volume jo kisi region ko ek axis ke gird ghumane (revolve karne) se banta hai, aur cross-section (kaat kar dekhne wala hissa) se volume.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Teeno kaamon ke peeche ek hi idea hai, aur yeh idea samajh liya to poora section aasaan ho jata hai.
Socho aap ek bari zameen ka area naapna chahte hain jis ki ek side seedhi nahi balke tedhi (curve) hai. Aap zameen ko bohat patli patli pattiyon (strips) mein kaat dete hain. Har patti taqreeban ek rectangle hai: chaurai (width) \(dx\) aur lambai (height) \(f(x)\), to us ka area \(f(x)\,dx\). Ab saari pattiyon ko jama kar dein: yahi jama integral \(\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\) hai.
Volume mein bhi yahi hota hai: patti ki jagah ek patli si gol tikiya (disk) aati hai, jis ka radius \(f(x)\) aur motai \(dx\) hai. Us ka volume \(\pi[f(x)]^2\,dx\) hai, aur saari tikiyon ka jama \(\int_a^b \pi[f(x)]^2\,dx\).
Yani har jagah tareeqa ek hai: tukde karo, ek tukde ka formula banao, aur integral se sab jama kar do.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar ek curve poori ki poori x-axis ke neeche ho to us ka integral positive aayega ya negative? Aur kya area kabhi negative ho sakta hai?
Jawab: integral negative aayega, kyunke har patti ki height \(f(x)\) negative hai; lekin area kabhi negative nahi hota, is liye hum us ki absolute value lete hain. Yeh baat 3.7.1 mein tafseel se aayegi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Definite integral bohat saare patle tukdon ko jama karta hai; isi liye yeh area, surplus aur volume teeno naap sakta hai.
2. Integrate karne se pehle hamesha ek kachcha sa sketch (rough drawing) banayein: is se limits, upar wala curve, aur axis ko kaatne wale points sab nazar aa jate hain.
3. Area aur volume kabhi negative nahi hote; negative integral sirf yeh batata hai ke region axis ke neeche hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sketch banaye baghair integrate karna aur ghalat limits laga dena.
2. Negative number ko hi area likh dena.
3. Units bhool jana: area square units mein, volume cubic units mein aur surplus rupees mein hota hai.
